name: Monique Pittas
title: Psychologist
description: Monique Pittas is a registered psychologist and Accredited EMDR Practitioner at Kind Mynd Psychology in Melbourne, Victoria. She offers EMDR Intensives for adults who want dedicated time to work through experiences that continue to affect how they feel, think and respond in the present. Monique works with people experiencing PTSD, single-incident trauma, anxiety, phobias and performance anxiety. Her approach is warm, collaborative and grounded in EMDR therapy.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, Anxiety, Panic attacks, Complicated grief, Body dysmorphic disorders, Performance anxiety, Stress reduction, Disturbing memories, Phobias, Womens health
